title: cloud-connection: the "Installed Apps" entry opens Setup Packages filtered to Source = marketplace (ruling B on #23892; after the objectui card lands and the pin moves)
body:
Filing gate: **④ a ruled execution card** — ruling B on #23892 (batch #356 item 2, the maintainer's 「同意」; the record's id is the first line of that card's body), item 2 of #23803. Filed by the director seat (summon #43, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`). ⛔ Not a claim. Facts were read at objectstack `origin/main` `d5666be876`.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#12675

## The work (`domain:cli`, `packages/cloud-connection`)

- `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts`, registered by `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` at `kernel:ready`, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:184`) keeps its nav entry and label; its target becomes Setup's Packages component opened with the Source = marketplace filter preset that objectstack-ai/objectui#12675 defines. The separate Installed Apps page bundle is no longer registered once that view serves the marketplace row actions.
- The entry still lives and dies with the capability (cloud ADR-0009 as restated in the file's header): no plugin, no entry.
- Any `content/docs` page that names the Installed Apps page follows the new target in the same PR.

## Pins

- Plugin present: the entry exists and opens the filtered Packages view; plugin absent: no entry.
- The filter preset's spelling is the one objectstack-ai/objectui#12675 published, read at the pinned `.objectui-sha` at landing.

## Order

After objectstack-ai/objectui#12675 lands and the objectui pin moves (the consumer must be installable, not merely merged). #23803 item 4's count is checked by whichever lands last.

## Dedupe

Open objectstack cards naming `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` or "Installed Apps" at filing: #23892 (the decision, closing with its record) and #23803 (the parent). Dedupe words: cloud-connection MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE Installed Apps entry target Packages Source filter.
